REGULATION (EU) 0000/0000 OF THE EXAMPLE PARLIAMENT

Article 5 is mentioned inside this recital and must not start an article.

CHAPTER I

General provisions

Article 1

Subject matter

1. This Regulation lays down rules about widgets.

2. It protects widget owners.

Article 2

Definitions

For the purposes of this Regulation:

(a)

‘widget’ means a small device;

(b)

‘owner’ means a person who owns a widget.

CHAPTER II

Obligations

Article 3

Duty to register

Owners shall register each widget within 30 days. Late registration is an infringement.

Article 3a

Lettered article

This article has a letter in its number.

Done at Brussels, 1 January 2000.

ANNEX I

List of widget types

1. Small widgets

2. Large widgets
